author.name: Naval Ravikant
author.heading: About Naval Ravikant
author.bio: Naval Ravikant co-founded the consumer-review company Epinions and the startup-investment platform AngelList. His How to Get Rich interviews with fellow founder Nivi turn that business experience into arguments about ownership, cooperation and personal freedom.

cite.sourceCitation: Ravikant, Naval, with Nivi. “Seek Wealth, Not Money or Status”. Naval, 2019-02-28. Edited online interview transcript.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Ravikant separates three things people often lump together: productive wealth, the money used to exchange it, and status in a social hierarchy. His aim is freedom from compulsory work, rather than conspicuous consumption or winning a ranking contest.
